resources.string: Sync attempt finished. Check the queue status below.
Cached estimates cleared. Your reports and observation sessions are kept.
Deletion requested. The old phone ID is retired and the report queue has been cleared.

This clears your reports and upload queue on this phone, withdraws research consent, and requests deletion from the server. Offline requests remain pending until acknowledged. A new random phone ID is created. Previously aggregated results may not be separable.
One alert for your chosen stage and route
Sign in with an assigned access code
Choose the language used throughout the app.
Kiswahili translations have not yet been reviewed by a fluent team member.
Uses your wallpaper palette on Android 12 or later. The NganyaFlow brand palette remains the default.
Browsing requires no account, research consent or location permission. Location stays on this phone and is used only when you request nearby stages.

Boarding reports contain a random phone ID, stage, route, direction, time and consent version. They contain no name, phone number or coordinates. You can undo individual reports in Activity. Withdrawal stops future contributions; Delete my data removes linked reports.
All acknowledged actions have been removed from the upload queue.
This clears estimates only. Reports, session history and unsent work are preserved.
Enter an HTTPS server origin. Debug builds also allow http://10.0.2.2:8000/ and localhost. The app checks /health before saving. Work and credentials stay scoped to their original server.
Research pilot for next-vehicle wait ranges. No estimate guarantees a vehicle or a seat. Current demo arrival times are simulated; accuracy figures describe the simulator, not Nairobi.
NganyaFlow: MIT licence. AndroidX, Kotlin and Material libraries: Apache 2.0. OkHttp and Retrofit: Apache 2.0. Route and stage attribution is supplied by the server above.
